title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: design custom AI agents with the AI development toolkit
summary: Hold: the assertion that agent-permissions automation is undocumented could not be established. Microsoft documents AL configuration methods but restricts cross-application changes, so their applicability to designer-created agents needs a narrower qualification; the roadmap facts, preview restrictions, capability default and credit-allocation paths are supported.

claims.fix: Remove the blanket 'Not yet documented' assertion for this automation side. Describe it narrowly as 'Learn documents AL Agent.UpdateAccessControl for permission sets and Agent.SetProfile for profiles; configuration across application boundaries is restricted, so these are not unrestricted administrator APIs for designer-created agents.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/ai/ai-development-toolkit-permissions and https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/ai/ai-agent-sdk-configuration#cross-agent-operations. If the structured table cannot represent this qualified state without asserting a runnable call for designer-created agents, remove controls[1] and its rendered row and retain the verified wizard path and this qualification in the section prose instead.
